threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think ordering coffee means a barista won’t judge you for asking for decaf. Just wait till you try the local roasts.
Saw a guy on the 77 last night arguing with his reflection in the window. Thought he was gonna start throwing punches at himself.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I heard a saxophonist jamming outside the Kottbusser Tor U-Bahn while a group of kids danced, I realized this place has a heartbeat like no other.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can get a currywurst with vegan sausage at almost every stand in Kreuzberg. Who knew meatless versions could taste so iconic?

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can name the taco truck parked at 16th and Mission before it moves on. It's like a neighborhood secret menu.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5-Fulton today, but it turned into a stand-up comedy show when the driver yelled at a passenger for trying to board with a parrot.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia’s only about the plazas, but it’s the little side streets with their hidden bars that reveal the heart of the neighborhood.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their heavy backpacks stuffed with maps – still looking puzzled at every corner, like they’re on a treasure hunt.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think you can catch a bus to the 'Tube'—everyone knows the hidden gems and shortcuts for that late-night trek home now.
Last night, caught a guy dancing with a street lamp at Brixton station. The bus was late, but he spun like it was his stage. Pure Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Last week, I saw a guy in a full suit juggling oranges at the U-Bahn station. Just another typical morning in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you enjoy a spontaneous rap battle while waiting for the bus during a strike. The chaos creates a uniquely creative vibe!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Locals know to avoid BART during Civic Center chaos; they just walk to get ahead of those waiting for the next train due to delays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the Muni this morning only to find it held for 20 mins due to a labradoodle blocking the tracks. Just another day in Civic Center.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar in Gràcia is open late, but many close by midnight. It’s all about the locals’ rhythm here.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by how they still carry a mapa in their hands, staring at it like it's a treasure map, rather than just using their phone.
